line: I wait for Sei-Wan, my kin. He walked out into the basin alone four hours ago.
He went to prove himself to Helstrom's Agaceph, the tribe that rules this city and that we belong to.
By the custom of the Agaceph, our own may not follow a walk-out. The levy will not go, and I may not.
It does not apply to an outsider. I do not know you, so I say only what you need.
He went east from the gate, through the shallows. Vipers live in the roots there.
Anyone who walks into the basin may die there. A warning is posted at the gate.
If you go, bring him home alive. If he can walk home himself, let the walk-out be his own.
